title:
This is a documentation type only for all the expression engine functions available in the C3 AI Suite.
This type does not support any implementation and {@see Expr#eval} should be used to evaluate the expression.

The following describes the functions available in the expression engine. These functions can be used in various layers in the C3 AI Suite, including, and not limited to: stored calcs, read calcs, data integration, metrics, and Expr.eval.

**User-defined functions:**`` To add your own user-defined function, see [Custom expression engine function.](custom-expression-engine-function.c3doc)
name: ExpressionEngineFunction
